articles.summary: Twenty-two college football student-athletes and honorary coach Kalani Sitake named to the 2026 Allstate AFCA Good Works Team, including the first female honoree in program history. One FBS player will earn the Allstate Wuerffel Trophy.
articles.title: 2026 Allstate AFCA Good Works Team contributes 12,000 service hours to strengthen communities

articles.summary: Built using insights from more than 100 million property claims, the Property Lab recreates realistic home damage scenarios to help claim adjusters build the expertise needed to guide customers through the repair process
articles.title: What is the Property Lab at Allstate Claims University? How Allstate trains property claims adjusters to help homeowners recover after damage
